core_claim.quote: If the theory is correct, then the attention schema, the construct of awareness, is relevant to any type of information to which the brain can pay attention.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

prediction.statement: Awareness reaches exactly as far as attention does: any kind of information the brain can attend to, outside (the senses) or inside (thoughts, emotions, memories), can be something a person is aware of.

first_stated.passage: If awareness is a model of attention, then this model should pertain to the same domains of information to which attention pertains.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015
